verdictBasis: The converged architecture repairs materially close R5R-DLTS-01, R5R-DLTS-02, R5R-DLTS-03, R5R-DLTS-04 and R6R-IP02-01. Independent encoders reproduce the signed default budget, wire and Coverage commitments, the full-profile PlanIntent commitment and PlanId, and both host-only FACT-ID-V1 vectors. The named v1 full-profile C-2/RI/DELIVERY provider seam is also repaired. The requested global provider-vector condition is not closed, however: C-2 still publishes valid-provider-plan with providerId=typescript, and check-c2.py accepts that vector after replacement by provider.typescript-semantic or an arbitrary identifier. IP-R4-02 also remains open rather than overclaimed: OPERABILITY still parks EvidenceBundle closure and mechanically reads evidence.v1.json, while the separate Evidence v2 owner has landed closure but its checker throws on hostile root and EvidenceBundle schema-type substitutions. More broadly, the explicit checker-totality requirement fails for every tested checker except DELIVERY. Green authored checkers are design-integrity evidence within their tested domains only; they are not implementation, qualification or demonstration evidence.

adversarialProbes.detail: All 63 non-empty subsets of the six exact TypeScript relations were C-2-valid and v1-overlay ALLOW. Derived full-key cardinality ranged from 1 to 9 for the closed two-universe v1 provider set. The FACT-PLANE host registry covers exactly all twelve live v1 relation kinds with unique opensip.relation.<kind>.v1 schema IDs, exact closed field sets, resolution rules and same-only/admitted-target universe rules.

Replacing both retained FactId vector outputs and both RequestId-variation outputs with the same valid-looking fact:sha256:ffff... string produced two F13 oracle findings plus F14. Adding a candidate-supplied factId, even equal to the correct host value, produced FACT_CANDIDATE_SCHEMA_INVALID. Replacing only the two canonical RequestIds with two other distinct canonical values left the checker clean and the independently recomputed FactId unchanged.

Thirty-six scalar/null/list/object replacements across wireSchema, frameSchemas, payloadSchemas, definitions, multiStageAnalyze, stageRequestProjection, coverageDomain, FactCandidateV1 and canonicalProviderIdJoin returned findings; zero exceptions and zero escapes. Root scalar/null/list/object probes also returned findings.

adversarialProbes.counterexample: c2-plan-stage-schema.v3.json#planFixtures[id=valid-provider-plan] is a positive semantic-provider vector with providerId=typescript. check-c2.py remained clean after changing that value independently to typescript-semantic, provider.typescript-semantic, and arbitrary-semantic-provider.
adversarialProbes.interpretation: C-2 may intentionally remain broader for explicitly future/general provider forms, but an unqualified positive vector named valid-provider-plan that looks like the TypeScript provider contradicts the requested exact vector namespace and the response's unqualified 'sole canonical IDs' statement.

adversarialProbes.axis: EvidenceBundle RequestId closure and OPERABILITY promotion boundary
adversarialProbes.detail: Evidence v2 declares recordSchemas.EvidenceBundle closed with additionalProperties=false, EVIDENCE_BUNDLE_UNKNOWN_FIELD and requestId forbidden, and retains evidence-bundle-reject-request-id. Its normal and selftest runs pass. OPERABILITY does not overclaim this proof: proofStatus still says PENDING-OWNER-INTEGRATION and check-operability.py loads evidence.v1.json/bundleSchema. Therefore the no-premature-promotion rule passes, but IP-R4-02 remains open because the landed owner proof is not consumed and the Evidence v2 checker is not total under the hostile-type corpus.

residualDecisions.evidence: StageRequest projection is now exact for absent/present dependsOn, absent signed defaults and work-units 1..INT64_MAX. All six budget counters receive the exact admitted limit. milliseconds, bytes and items are pre-attempt v1 overlay denials; unknown units and out-of-range limits fail C-2. The default profile digest and PlanId binding independently reproduce.
residualDecisions.qualification: This is an implementable contract and checker result, not a built host/provider demonstration.

residualDecisions.evidence: The host-owned closed payload registry is exact over all twelve v1 relations. Every FactCandidate field has one destination or explicit transport-only exclusion; SnapshotId/factId are host-injected; confidence/span/payload text are deterministic derivations. Source/target universe and typed anchor admission rules are exact. DELIVERY joins the live FACT-PLANE component IDs and TypeScript profile.
residualDecisions.qualification: Subject to the separate checker-totality finding; no provider implementation or corpus was evaluated.

newFindings.title: The cross-checker parsed-JSON totality requirement is false outside DELIVERY
newFindings.evidence: The exact four-value root corpus (string, null, array, empty object) raised uncaught TypeError/AttributeError/KeyError in fact-plane, fact-identity, resolved-inputs, C-2 and D9 for every value; OPERABILITY, assurance and product-dispositions threw for scalar/null/list. Evidence v2 threw for all four roots and for scalar/null/list at recordSchemas.EvidenceBundle. DELIVERY alone returned findings for all roots and all 36 nested protocol substitutions.
newFindings.falsifier: Invoke each public check()/validate() entry point with the four successfully parsed JSON values. For Evidence, additionally replace recordSchemas.EvidenceBundle with each value. Any exception reproduces the finding.
newFindings.impact: Automation receives uncategorized exceptions for legal JSON of the wrong schema type, while green selftests overstate the domain on which the checkers are total. Evidence v2's module docstring specifically claims these paths never raise.
newFindings.requiredChange: Add an object-root guard and a narrow totality wrapper to every affected checker, type-guard nested containers before indexing/.get/iteration, and retain the exact four-type root corpus plus representative nested schema substitutions. A malformed base must yield one or more stable findings and a nonzero checker exit, never a traceback.

newFindings.title: A positive C-2 TypeScript-looking provider vector remains outside the canonical v1 namespace
newFindings.evidence: c2-plan-stage-schema.v3.json#planFixtures[id=valid-provider-plan] is valid=true, operator=semantic-provider and providerId=typescript. The requested canonical IDs are rust-semantic and typescript-semantic. check-c2.py accepts replacements by provider.typescript-semantic and arbitrary-semantic-provider because only identifier syntax is checked for this vector.
newFindings.falsifier: Set that vector's providerId to provider.typescript-semantic and run check-c2.check with live dependencies; it returns zero findings.
newFindings.impact: The exact joined V1 FULL PROFILE seam is correct, but the repository still publishes and checker-accepts a plausible TypeScript provider alias in a positive vector, contradicting global exactness and the response's unqualified 'sole canonical IDs' claim.
newFindings.requiredChange: Use typescript-semantic in this positive vector and assert it in check-c2.py, or clearly reclassify it as an explicitly future/non-v1 provider-generic fixture. Keep future C-2 ontology separate from the shipping provider identity oracle.

newFindings.title: The landed Evidence v2 RequestId closure is not consumed by OPERABILITY
newFindings.evidence: Evidence v2 and its checker now mechanically bind a closed EvidenceBundle, deterministic unknown-field outcome, forbidden requestId and a named counterexample. OPERABILITY proofStatus still says PENDING-OWNER-INTEGRATION; check-operability.py sets EVIDENCE=evidence.v1.json and reads bundleSchema rather than evidence.v2.json recordSchemas.
newFindings.falsifier: Delete or reopen the Evidence v2 RequestId closure while leaving evidence.v1 and the deferred patch unchanged; check-operability.py remains green because it does not consume the owner proof.
newFindings.impact: OPERABILITY correctly avoids a paper overclaim, but IP-R4-02 cannot be called closed and the now-landed owner result can drift independently.
newFindings.requiredChange: After check-evidence totality and independent Evidence review are clean, bind OPERABILITY to the exact Evidence v2 schema/fixture/checker surface and promote it mechanically; until then retain the current pending posture.

priorArtifactReconciliation.result: R5R-DLTS-01 through -04 counterexamples are repaired on current hashes. The original provider.* full-profile contradiction in -05 is repaired, but Reviewer9 found the separate positive C-2 providerId=typescript vector and therefore does not accept the broader exact-vector closure claim.

R6R-IP02-01 is repaired: the generic FactId is exact and the equal-junk counterexample no longer survives. Reviewer6's Evidence owner condition has landed in Evidence v2, but OPERABILITY has not promoted/consumed it and the Evidence checker is not total under the required hostile corpus, so IP-R4-02 remains conditional/open.
Its two independent FactId vector values and full-profile PlanIntent/PlanId values reproduce exactly. Its IMPLEMENTABLE_UNEXECUTED/no-product-evidence posture is correct.

The architectural repairs and 93/93 authored mutations reproduce, but the response's 'sole canonical IDs' statement is too broad in light of valid-provider-plan, and the DELIVERY-only totality repair must not be generalized to the other checkers.

requiredChangesForCleanRereview: Close R9-CHECKER-TOTALITY-01 with retained root and nested hostile-type corpora across every required checker, including Evidence v2.
Resolve R9-PROVIDER-VECTOR-01 without adding provider aliases to DELIVERY.
Keep IP-R4-02 explicitly open until the Evidence v2 proof is total, independently reviewed and mechanically consumed by OPERABILITY; then retire the evidence.v1/deferred-patch join.
Rerun all normal/selftests and independent PlanIntent, PlanId, FACT-ID, budget, wire and Coverage oracles after any binding change and reject any hash drift not explicitly reviewed.
